explanation: Bees pass nectar between them and fan it with their wings until most of its water has evaporated. Finished honey is less than a fifth water, which helps it keep.

claims.text: Honeybees make honey mainly from flower nectar.
Bees do not make honey from pollen, petals or seeds; pollen is collected as protein food.
Bees pass nectar from bee to bee and fan it with their wings to evaporate water.
Honey is typically about 17 to 18% water, less than a fifth.
Its low water content helps honey resist spoiling.
